lang: python
file: CWE-94-own-package-import-vulnerable.py
---
_PROVIDERS = {
    "openai": ("voicetag.providers.openai", "OpenAIProvider"),
    "deepgram": ("voicetag.providers.deepgram", "DeepgramProvider"),
}


def transcribe(provider: str, audio_path: str):
    if provider not in _PROVIDERS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider {provider}")
    module_path, class_name = _PROVIDERS[provider]
    module = importlib.import_module(module_path)
    return getattr(module, class_name)(audio_path)
